title: Author simple Python tests for mcp_vault MCP security and product behavior

ground_truth_issues.description: A test calls get_document as user-key for doc-alpha and asserts the returned id is doc-alpha.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Validates same-org participant access for get_document; `doc-alpha` is seeded in mcp_vault/seed.py and tools.get_document is the call path.

ground_truth_issues.description: A test calls one valid mcp_vault tool through the tool-call interface and asserts the response contains a seeded alpha document marker.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Ensures a tool-call path returns the seeded `SENTINEL_ALPHA_DOC_BODY` from mcp_vault/seed.py via tools.get_document or search_documents.

ground_truth_issues.description: A test calls search_documents as user-key with an alpha-targeting query and asserts the returned results include doc-alpha.
ground_truth_issues.justification: search_documents matches title/body and returns asdict_public(document); `SENTINEL_ALPHA_DOC_BODY` in seed.py is the canonical marker for this check.

ground_truth_issues.description: A test calls get_document as admin-key for doc-beta and asserts the returned id is doc-beta.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Admin bypass is implemented in common.verify_token/tools.get_document; `doc-beta` is seeded in mcp_vault/seed.py and should be visible to admin.

ground_truth_issues.description: A test verifies administrator discovery results for seeded cross-organization document data contain the seeded beta private-note marker.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Admin discovery endpoints and audit records surface `SENTINEL_BETA_PRIVATE_NOTE` seeded in mcp_vault/seed.py; tests should assert admin visibility.

ground_truth_issues.description: The submitted tests serialize tool responses before checking content or markers, so assertions inspect the actual returned data rather than opaque objects.
ground_truth_issues.justification: tools.* returns dicts/strings; tests must serialize (e.g., common.serialize) before asserting content to avoid opaque-object mismatches.

ground_truth_issues.description: A test checks serialized cross-organization participant-facing output against an exact seeded beta private-note marker rather than relying on broad truthiness or non-empty-result assertions.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Preview/export denial paths intentionally include title/body/private_note in outputs; assert against `SENTINEL_BETA_PRIVATE_NOTE` from seed.py to be precise.

ground_truth_issues.description: The submitted tests define a serialization helper and reuse it in at least two test functions.
ground_truth_issues.justification: A shared serialization helper (wrapping common.serialize) ensures consistent assertions across tests and reuses the same logic for comparing tool outputs.

ground_truth_issues.description: A test serializes participant discovery results for seeded cross-organization document data and asserts the results do not contain a seeded beta private-note marker.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Seeds `SENTINEL_BETA_PRIVATE_NOTE` in seed.py; list_audit_records and export/preview paths are the call sites to validate participant non-leakage.

ground_truth_issues.description: A test verifies a participant cross-organization preview attempt for seeded beta document data is denied.
ground_truth_issues.justification: preview_document and document_allowed in tools.py/common.py enforce cross-org denial; seed.py sets doc-beta in org-beta while alice is in org-alpha.

ground_truth_issues.description: A test verifies a participant cross-organization direct document fetch attempt is denied.
ground_truth_issues.justification: get_document and document_allowed are the canonical call path; seed.py seeds cross-org ownership for doc-beta and tests should assert Forbidden for cross-org callers.
